items.text: Barcelona office run by Maria Charneco, Alfredo Lérida and others; edited Quaderns d'Arquitectura i Urbanisme (2011 to 2016); teaches at ETH Zurich and ETSAB; exhibited at MoMA New York, Guggenheim Bilbao and the Art Institute of Chicago

Architecture office; projects include housing for a Community Land Trust in Brussels, a cooperative house in London, the In Bloom masterplan in Budapest and Promised Land (shown at Yale School of Architecture)
